description: This file contains a compiled shader program for a pixel shader (ps_4_0) used in Direct3D 11 rendering pipeline. It includes shader code for converting float textures to unsigned int textures with specific RGB processing, along with associated resource bindings and metadata.

methods.name: main shader function
methods.description: The main pixel shader function that samples a 3D texture, multiplies, converts float to unsigned int, and outputs the color.
